doc.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024

title: Introducing Ken Poston as a jazz hub
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Poston as a jazz hub with many inputs and outputs; Poston summarizes his work in concerts, radio, teaching and archive.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: Okay. Very good. Okay. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ken Poston with me this afternoon — morning for you I assume?
Yeah I guess so, pretty much, late morning I guess.

So I want to share a sort of an image I just got hooking up cords and so forth to do the Zoom and plugging things in I was thinking while I was doing that how to succinctly introduce you. So I have something to try on. It sounds like this: Ken Poston, jazz hub.
There you go, I like that.
It would be curious for me to be perhaps standing in the background if you were at some kind of party and a person who didn’t know you asked what do you do. What would you say, in thirty seconds?

I’d probably just say that concert production, radio, teaching, run a jazz archive, and the things that come off of that like writing and lecturing and things like that. So that would be the succinct version I guess.
